topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins affects link budgets by increasing interference, reducing bandwidth, and straining adaptive coding strategies. This compromises navigation signal reliability due to increased noise floor, propagation losses, and potential failures in error correction.
reference_context: QoS provisioning surveys highlight the importance of link characteristic identification and traffic requirement analysis for reliable communication.
